text:
[issue by 7OOTnegaTerces]
### Describe the bug

You cannot load a Memory Card with any settings if you have something in your off hand.  **This is not mentioned ANYWHERE in the documentation!  I spent literal DAYS going insane trying to figure out why I, and I alone, couldn't get the Memory Card to work!**  Please update the documentation with a warning that your off hand must be empty to load configurations into the Memory Card, so others don't have to suffer as I did...

Could you please also update the error that this action gives so that anyone who does try to use a Memory Card while their off hand is full gets the correct error message and can know what's actually wrong and how to fix it.  The current error message: "Could not load configuration from an incompatible device" makes it seem as if there's something broken in the mod itself so that it's no longer recognizing it's own stuff as belonging to it, and gives absolutely no hint that the bug might in fact be caused by the user having something in their off hand...  Something like "Could not load configuration, device in off hand incompatible" would be much better!

That is all, thank you.

### How to reproduce the bug

1. Get yourself a Memory Card.
2. Get an AE2 block that you can load data from into the cad (any machine, or a pattern provider or a P2P tunnel, anything, doesn't matter) and place it in the world.
3. Put any random item in your off hand.
4. Attempt to load data from the block in step two with the memory card by shift right clicking.
5. Instead of the Memory Card being loaded with data from the block, get the error: "Could not load configuration from an incompatible device"

### Expected behavior

1. Get yourself a Memory Card.
2. Get an AE2 block that you can load data from into the cad (any machine, or a pattern provider or a P2P tunnel, anything, doesn't matter) and place it in the world.
3. Put any random item in your off hand.
4. Attempt to load data from the block in step two with the memory card by shift right clicking.
5. Instead of the Memory Card being loaded with data from the block, get the error: "Could not load configuration, device in off hand incompatible" as this would clue the user into the actual issue at hand (literally)...

### Additional details

_No response_

### Which minecraft version are you using?

1.21

### On which mod loaders does it happen?

NeoForge

### Crash log

NA, does not cause a crash.

[comment by HaphLife (contributor)]
This seems to me that it's more likely a bug that you can't use the memory card with items in your offhand than that the goal was to not allow that, but the team forgot to clearly record it.

Obviously, yes, for as long as the bug persists, it would be good to be clear on how it works, but why *shouldn't* memory cards work while an item in in your offhand?

[comment by Mari023 (collaborator)]
It isn't documented because it is a bug.

(as to why this is *still* a bug, that is a good question)

[comment by 7OOTnegaTerces (none)]
> It isn't documented because it is a bug.
> 
> (as to why this is _still_ a bug, that is a good question)

Oh, well I thought that maybe there were times when you could put an item in your off hand and use the memory card on it, so it was an intended feature...

Regardless, until this is fixed, better documentation or at least error reporting would help users deal with this bug in the meantime.  So please at least fix the error message to something like what I suggested!!!
